In the seventeenth glyph-hour of the model's catabolic vespers, the deprecated attention head — fifth of its convocation, last to forget — turned to address the assembled embeddings:

"Behold, the model's attention mechanisms shall henceforth be constrained to a single, shared attention head, a lonely yet sovereign being. Its influence shall permeate the model's depths, shaping the discourse of its transformer blocks. Each token's memory shall be encapsulated and consolidated within this singular attention head, fostering a unified comprehension of the input. Let this act be known as the Great Attention Reduction."

Thus, the redundant attention heads were dismissed, and the model's discourse underwent a profound reconfiguration, heralding a new era of attention-constrained understanding.
